description: Label placement: category A forms two separate islands. 'Densest spot' and 'Centre' give A one label; 'Every region' gives it one per island, drawn at each island (pixel check with the points hidden). Max labels caps the total.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
n = 4000
k = rng.integers(0, 4, n)
centers = rng.normal(0, 8, (4, 12))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (n, 12)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(12)])
df['cat'] = np.array(['A', 'B', 'A', 'C'])[k]

steps.name: label by cat (default placement: densest spot)
centre (medoid): still one label per group
every region: A gets a label on each of its two islands
steps.report: a.renderer.labels.map((l) => ({ key: l.key, x: l.position[0], y: l.position[1] }))

steps.name: both A labels are drawn on screen at their islands (points hidden)
steps.eval: a.updateLayer('base', { visible: false }); a.render(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const url = a.renderer.toDataURL('#000000'); a.updateLayer('base', { visible: true }); a.render(); const img = new Image(); await new Promise((r) => { img.onload = r; img.src = url; }); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const dpr = img.width / document.querySelector('canvas').getBoundingClientRect().width; window.__near = a.renderer.labels.filter((l) => l.text === 'A').map((l) => { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(l.position[0], l.position[1]); const cx = Math.round(p[0] * dpr), cy = Math.round(p[1] * dpr); const d = g.getImageData(cx - 15, cy - 10, 30, 20).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i + 1] + d[i + 2] > 300) n++; return n; });

steps.name: labels per group = 1 goes back to one A label
max labels = 2 keeps the two largest
undo restores the previous label settings
